title: POST /api/decks/areas/:uid/judge/quote and POST /api/decks/areas/:uid/judge (D1525, #3783)
description: What the deck v2 adapter's `judge` method passes through. Without `run`, the quote: `ai` with the judge's hold (input tokens only), its model label and family, the writers' families and how many variants it ranks; or `ai: false` with the reason (a writer of the judge's family, a writer that cannot be read, fewer than two variants with words). With `run`, the ranking: each judged variant's rank and Clef's probability (null when it sent none), its "Ranked n of m" line, the best, the score AUTO-5 holds against the threshold, the panel's agreement, and what the run charged (null when not recorded); or `ranked: false` with the reason. A model id never rides on the reply. D1511 (#3762).
